# Generic runtime conformance fixture

This fixture is generated by `generic_runtime_conformance_fixture_generator`
from the SchemaIR definition in its source. The generator uses
`LayoutComputer`, `QbsModelBuilder`, the QBS serializer, and the generic BRF
encoder. It writes `schema.qbs` and `record.brf` only when explicitly passed
`--write <directory>`; otherwise it checks an existing directory.

The root record is `Parent` (record ID 1). It contains unsigned and signed
integers, bool, float32/float64, enum, UTF-8 text, bytes, a primitive array,
a nested `Child`, an `Item[]` record array, an absent optional string, and a
present-empty primitive array. Items contain a scalar and a nested Child.
